definitions.explanation: A sweet, viscous liquid. Refers to honey produced by bees, nectar from flowers, or sweet syrup used in cooking and confectionery. The base component of many compound words related to sweetness.

examples.english: To sip the nectar of flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蜜|みつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パンケーキ→パンケーキ：28809_pankeeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蜜|みつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦かかっていて→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{甘|あま}くて→甘い：00617_amai⟧おいしい。
examples.english: These pancakes have plenty of syrup on them and are very sweet and delicious.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both on its own and as a component in compounds. On its own, can refer to honey, flower nectar, or sweet syrup depending on context. Very productive as a word-forming element.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{蜂蜜|はちみつ}→蜂蜜：14045_hachimitsu⟧: honey (bee honey)
- {花蜜|かみつ}: flower nectar
- ⟦{蜜蜂|みつばち}→蜜蜂：06514_mitsubachi⟧: honeybee
- {蜜柑|みかん}: mandarin orange
- {蜜|みつ}{豆|まめ}: mitsumame (traditional Japanese dessert with sweet syrup)
- ⟦{黒蜜|くろみつ}→黒蜜：24332_kuromitsu⟧: brown sugar syrup

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蜜|みつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to pour syrup/honey on
- {蜜|みつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect nectar
- {蜜|みつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: the taste of honey; (figuratively) a sweet/irresistible taste
